services.name: Book Your Cruise!
services.desc: The BrewBoat’s Cruise Coordinators assist the Captain in the safe and courteous operation of BrewBoat CLE and perform regular customer service activities during BrewBoat cruises. Cruise Coordinators are responsible for keeping the boat in a clean and safe condition, ensuring guest satisfaction, and assisting customers on and off the boat. WAGE: $15 per hour, plus tips (Tips usually range from $50-100 per day!) HOURS: Full-Time: 32-40 per week / Part-Time: 12-24 per week, dependant upon booking capacity FILING DEADLINE: Open until filled The BrewBoat’s Dock Directors are our land-based customer service specialists, responsible for checking-in and boarding guests, answering calls and texts,
